interpretation: 2017-2021 is internal chronological walk-forward / pseudo-OOS generalization evidence because V3 was designed after V1/V2 Development research; untouched Validation remains 2022-2023

comparable_price_chain.source: PIT daily raw OHLC plus registered corporate-action terms
comparable_price_chain.valid_ordinary_step: adjacent market session, both rows hard-valid/tradable, and zero current action
comparable_price_chain.valid_action_step: announcement available no later than effective trade date, no rights, positive share multiplier, and positive cash-adjusted prior close
comparable_price_chain.invalid_step: fail closed for every feature window/path crossing it
comparable_price_chain.adjusted_close: cumulative valid step log return; ratios are admitted only when their entire required path contains no invalid step

former_leader.leader_percentile_formula: same-date same-board PIT-eligible percent_rank of valid 60-session adjusted return, ascending so strongest=1
required: no invalid comparable-price step in runup or peak-to-pregap path

strict_gap.coordinates: raw comparable executable prices after zero-action adjacent-session gate

post_gap_dryup.numerator: median turnover_fraction of up to the latest 3 valid completed sessions strictly after gap date and strictly before first reclaim date
post_gap_dryup.denominator: median turnover_fraction of exactly the latest 20 valid completed sessions strictly before gap date
post_gap_dryup.same_day: unavailable and eligible only when filter is NONE

intraday_dryup.source: authoritative V1 pre-cross amount divided by 20-session historical same-clock median
intraday_dryup.crossing_bar: excluded in full because within-minute ordering is unavailable

compression: authoritative V1 causal CompressionTrend; descriptive and composite-ranker only

rankers.DRYUP: ascending intraday_dryup then ascending post_gap_dryup with unavailable last
rankers.COMPOSITE: equal-weight within-timestamp normalized ranks of stronger leadership, larger runup, deeper drawdown, larger strict gap, lower intraday dryup, lower compression, younger age, plus lower post-gap dryup when available
rankers.other_missing_rank_inputs: rank last; no forward fill or outcome-based substitution

portfolio.year_boundary: entry admitted only if selected exit is no later than fold/test terminal date
portfolio.combined: fixed 50/50 initial sleeves with no transfer or rebalancing

breadth.diagnostic: fold-training-derived board-specific V2 DownGapBreadth Q75/Q90 only
